stat_data.label: Sensex crash to 3-month low
stat_data.context: Indha madhiri sharp fall-ah paathu ungaloda SIP matrum long-term holdings-ah disturb panneengalana, adhu unga compounding wealth-ku periya friction aagum.

slides.title: Eppo thaan ungalukku trap puriyudhu?
slides.card_text: Neenga headline-ah paathu 'market ippo innum keezhe pogum' nu nenaikireenga. Aana institutions andha support zone-la quietly accumulate panranga. Ungaloda panic order-than unga portfolio-oda silent killer.

slides.title: Volatility-ai eppadi capital aakuvathu?
slides.card_text: Smart money oru podhum emotion-la trade panrathu illa. Avanga delivery percentages matrum institutional order flows-ah track panni, retail panic sell panra time-la entry kudukkum moolamaa profit make panranga.

slides.title: The non-negotiable golden rule for traders.
slides.card_text: Never chase a headline move without verifying volume distribution and delivery percentages. Oru break down-oilla breakout-o nadakkum podhu, volume support irukka nu paarkamal blind entry kudukkave kudathu.

checklist_data.text: News-ah paathu yosikkamal panic sell panrathu
Trade-ku munbu volume matrum delivery data-va check panrathu
Strict stop-loss-oda unga capital-ah protect panrathu
